scope: Dated public dependency advisory observations for GB-T0.G1; no product runtime or security certification.

credential_controls: Distinct empty temporary user and global npm configuration files.
No project .npmrc present for the installed-root audit.
Token, auth, secret, password, npm_config and node_options environment keys removed without logging values.
Explicit public registry https://registry.npmjs.org; lifecycle scripts disabled.

observations.command: npm --userconfig=<empty temporary file> --globalconfig=<different empty temporary file> --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org audit --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --json
